notes: FrontRow (a Boxlight brand) classroom sound-reinforcement "digital communication platform" — a self-amplified 2.1 speaker tower with mixed audio inputs, IR reception for wireless pendant/student microphones, and Bluetooth. Ports listed are for the base "Juno" tower (front + back panel) per the manufacturer datasheet (Juno Datasheet-RevH). Bluetooth is wireless-only and is not listed as a physical port. The datasheet lists "3 RCA stereo audio in jacks" (interpreted here as 3 L/R pairs = 6 RCA jacks) and "2 RCA jacks for external sensor connection" — exact rear-panel silkscreen labels were not confirmed beyond the spec-table wording. DC power input is a barrel/coaxial jack fed by an external 18VDC @ 3.3A supply; exact barrel diameter not stated for the Juno tower itself (a related accessory, the POE Extractor, uses a 2.1mm barrel, used here as the closest connector match: dc-barrel). No bandwidth-graded ports exist on the base unit, so no "grade" fields are set. Installing the optional Communication Module converts the unit into "Juno Connect," adding: an RJ45 Intercom port, an RJ45 LAN port (for FrontRow Conductor campus communication), and an RS-232 serial control port on a captive terminal block (labeled "COM (RS232)") — these are NOT included in the port list below since they belong to the optional module/variant, not the base Juno. Rack units omitted — this is a freestanding/portable tower, not rack-mountable. Manufacturer sold under "FrontRow by Boxlight" branding; "FrontRow" used as manufacturer per on-product branding.
